svg.title: SalesGenie detailed database ER diagram — all eight tables
svg.desc: All columns, SQL types, nullability, primary keys, foreign keys, and relationships for the eight-table SQLAlchemy schema. Six child tables relate to leads. Import batches are separate import-operation records and have no lead foreign key.
svg.text: All 8 tables • every column and key • SQLAlchemy / Alembic • SQLite + PostgreSQL
PK = primary key • FK = foreign key to leads.lead_id • NULL = Yes means optional
On delete: CASCADE insights/scores/drafts/activities; SET NULL conversation summaries and agent runs.
import_batches is independent and has no lead_id FK; imported lead rows are stored in leads.
TIMESTAMPTZ means timezone-aware timestamp (PostgreSQL); SQLite stores the SQLAlchemy DateTime equivalent.
* Lead duplicate matching uses normalized partial unique indexes. Defaults and constraints follow migration 0001_initial.
